rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a serious, prolonged lack of rain.

example.english: There has been little rain for several years, and the drought is severe.
example.traditional: 呢個地區連續幾年少雨，旱災情況好嚴重。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 dei6 keoi1 lin4 zuk6 gei2 nin4 siu2 jyu5 hon5 zoi1 cing4 fong3 hou2 jim4 zung6

rows.note: Use this for a team or person going through a prolonged slump without success.

example.english: Our team has been losing a lot lately and is still in a drought.
example.traditional: 我哋隊波近排成日輸，仲喺低潮。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 deoi6 bo1 gan6 paai4 seng4 jat6 syu1 zung6 hai2 dai1 ciu4

rows.note: Use this specifically when a football team or player has gone a long time without scoring.

example.english: This team's scoring drought has lasted a whole month.
example.traditional: 呢隊波嘅入球荒持續咗成個月。
example.jyutping: nei1 deoi6 bo1 ge3 jap6 kau4 fong1 ci4 zuk6 zo2 seng4 go3 jyut6
